definition.name: Actual byte-copy retirement, failed lowering and original finite limits

steps.name: Retain exact explicit native source before compilation
steps.run:
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/random-byte-lowering"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = '${{ github.sha }}'
git archive --format=tar.gz HEAD -- Cargo.toml Cargo.lock rust-toolchain.toml .cargo/config.toml apps crates sdk/rust tools/optimization-workloads > "$RUNNER_TEMP/random-byte-lowering/source.tar.gz"
test "$(stat --format=%s "$RUNNER_TEMP/random-byte-lowering/source.tar.gz")" -le 134217728
sha256sum "$RUNNER_TEMP/random-byte-lowering/source.tar.gz" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/random-byte-lowering/source.sha256"

steps.name: Execute all original random controls plus sequential and failed byte lowering
steps.run:
set -o pipefail
cargo test --locked -p latent-wasmtime --test random -- --list > "$RUNNER_TEMP/random-byte-lowering/all.list"
cargo test --locked -p latent-wasmtime --test random -- --ignored --list > "$RUNNER_TEMP/random-byte-lowering/ignored.list"
cargo test --locked -p latent-wasmtime --test random -- --show-output 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/random-byte-lowering/random.log"
test "$(stat --format=%s "$RUNNER_TEMP/random-byte-lowering/random.log")" -le 16777216
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,os,pathlib
from tools import ci_suite_discovery as discovery, ci_suite_inventory as registry
root=pathlib.Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP'])/'random-byte-lowering'
suite=next(s for s in registry.load()['suites'] if s['id']=='latent-wasmtime.test.random')
available=discovery.listing((root/'all.list').read_bytes())
ignored=discovery.listing((root/'ignored.list').read_bytes())
discovery.validate_cases(suite,available,ignored,{})
required=set(['audit::required_audit_records_operations_and_outcomes_without_generated_bytes_or_digests', 'both_os_methods_execute_on_a_reused_cell_and_have_no_dormant_entropy_owner', 'cancellation_before_and_after_entropy_prevents_delivery_and_reclaims_the_store', 'denied_principal_and_retired_provider_never_access_entropy', 'failed_entropy_never_returns_partial_bytes_and_does_not_refund_attempted_bytes', 'ownership::a_second_provider_with_identical_metadata_cannot_borrow_the_installed_grant', 'ownership::abandoned_pending_calls_refund_aggregate_but_started_failures_spend_it', 'ownership::byte_destination_and_realloc_failures_retire_original_output_before_fresh_use', 'ownership::fuel_and_buffer_capacity_are_reserved_before_entropy_or_result_allocation', 'ownership::original_output_owner_outlives_closed_session_and_cancelled_pending_work_skips_entropy', 'ownership::scalar_lowering_destination_errors_and_provider_errors_reclaim_original_calls', 'ownership::sequential_byte_copies_retire_after_actual_lowering_without_widening_limits', 'ownership::sequential_u64_results_retire_after_lowering_before_the_next_call', 'ownership::uninstalled_random_import_is_rejected_before_any_store', 'ownership::variable_list_results_keep_the_original_store_owned_lowering_limit', 'revocation_after_one_guest_call_denies_the_next_without_reusing_cached_authority', 'zero_max_overflow_and_shared_aggregate_return_exact_typed_results'])
assert required <= available - ignored
passed,skipped=discovery.execution_cases((root/'random.log').read_bytes(),available,ignored)
(root/'tests.json').write_text(json.dumps({'source':os.environ['GITHUB_SHA'],'cases':passed,'passed':len(passed),'failed':0,'ignored':len(skipped),'filtered':0,'randomByteLimitRaised':False,'otherListRetentionChanged':False},indent=2)+'\n')
PY

steps.name: Build only the selected normal host for the subsequent library experiment
steps.run:
cargo build --locked -p latentd --bin latentd --message-format=json-render-diagnostics > "$RUNNER_TEMP/random-byte-lowering/native-build.jsonl"
test "$(stat --format=%s "$RUNNER_TEMP/random-byte-lowering/native-build.jsonl")" -le 16777216
python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,shutil,subprocess
root=pathlib.Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP'])/'random-byte-lowering'
rows=[json.loads(line) for line in (root/'native-build.jsonl').read_bytes().splitlines()]
artifacts=[r for r in rows if r.get('reason')=='compiler-artifact' and r['target']['name']=='latentd' and r.get('executable')]
assert len(artifacts)==1
artifact=artifacts[0];binary=pathlib.Path(artifact['executable'])
assert binary.is_file() and not binary.is_symlink() and 0<binary.stat().st_size<=512*1024**2
assert artifact['features']==[] and artifact['profile']=={'opt_level':'0','debuginfo':0,'debug_assertions':True,'overflow_checks':True,'test':False}
source=os.environ['GITHUB_SHA']
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD']).decode().strip()==source
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain']).strip()
binary_hash='sha256:'+hashlib.file_digest(binary.open('rb'),'sha256').hexdigest()
shutil.copyfile(binary,root/'latentd')
info={'schemaVersion':'latent.random-byte-lowering.host.v1','compiledSource':source,'sourceArchive':{'sha256':'sha256:'+hashlib.sha256((root/'source.tar.gz').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'bytes':(root/'source.tar.gz').stat().st_size},'binary':{'sha256':binary_hash,'bytes':binary.stat().st_size},'features':artifact['features'],'profile':artifact['profile'],'ordinaryDefaults':True,'hermetic':False,'implicitCompilerInputs':'not-attested','tests':json.loads((root/'tests.json').read_bytes())}
(root/'current-host.json').write_text(json.dumps(info,indent=2)+'\n')
PY
